intent: Live in-app AI chat on the shared tools with multi-provider inference (Claude, DeepSeek, Hermes, OpenRouter) and audit logging.
summary: Implemented the live in-app AI chat assistant (PSI-076). CODE: (1) Model resolver extended in src/agent/models.ts to support deepseek: (<model_id>), openrouter: (<model_id>), openai-compatible:, and hermes: in addition to anthropic: for cheaper inference. (2) AI SDK tools adapter src/agent/adapters/ai-sdk.ts: converts all 6 shared agent tools (get_board, get_agenda, get_activity, get_inbox, get_finance, search_documents) into AI SDK tool definitions executing within the caller's RLS session and audited with client_id: 'in-app'. (3) Streaming chat route src/app/api/chat/route.ts: gated by agent.chat permission, executes streamText with stopWhen: stepCountIs(5), system prompt grounding responses to tool outputs, and streams responses via toUIMessageStreamResponse(). (4) Interactive Chat UI in src/features/ai-chat/components/ai-chat-interface.tsx: uses DefaultChatTransport to /api/chat, renders dynamic tool calling markers/outputs, citations, reasoning parts, suggested starters, and clear chat. (5) Unit tests: 2 tests in src/agent/adapters/ai-sdk.test.ts, 3 tests in src/app/api/chat/__tests__/chat-route.test.ts, 5 tests in src/agent/__tests__/models.test.ts. Suite: 120 frontend tests pass, 22 edge function tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.
